biography: Pre-final year B.Tech student at IIT Patna, working across machine learning, AI agents and backend engineering. Since April 2026 I have been a research assistant at Drisha Lab with Prof. Sriparna Saha, studying how sequence models trained on cricket transfer across formats and seasons; our paper is under review at ACL. I also build systems end to end: a 100,000-candidate ranking engine, a cricket squad optimiser that is live on the web, and a crash-safe runtime for coding agents. Outside the lab I coordinate the Vincetroke Fine Arts Club and lead production for TEDx IIT Patna.

description: Built a sequence prediction benchmark across 5,593 matches (2.04M events, 1.82M windows) in 6 environments, to measure out-of-distribution transfer under format and temporal shifts.
Designed CricEnvGate, a 4-layer Transformer with soft gating that separates invariant representations from domain context.
Ran 284 controlled experiments across 6 domain-generalisation objectives on 2× H100 GPUs.
Paper submitted to ACL, currently under review.

projects.title: AgentForge
projects.description: A durable execution runtime for repository-repair agents. Submit a job, inspect every model and tool step, and resume from the last committed checkpoint after a worker crash.
highlights: PostgreSQL is both queue and state store: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claims, expiring leases and fencing tokens, with each step, checkpoint and event committed atomically.
A crashed run resumes from its latest checkpoint. Submissions are idempotent, retries are bounded with jitter, and every run has a deadline and a token and cost budget.
Vendor-neutral OpenAI and Gemini adapters sit behind a rules-based cost and fallback router, recorded in every trace.
Tools run in disposable Docker containers: non-root, no network, read-only root filesystem, with CPU, memory, PID and time limits.
React and TypeScript dashboard for runs, timelines, checkpoints and providers, deployed on Azure, plus a 45-second launch film built with Remotion and Three.js.

projects.title: NEW_X1 · Cricket Performance Intelligence
projects.description: Analyses upcoming T20, ODI and Test fixtures, predicts each player's performance and recommends the playing XI. It started as a Dream11 team predictor and grew into a live web platform.
highlights: Leakage-free pipeline over 8,700+ matches: 191,462 records and 324 features, refreshed daily from Cricsheet.
A stacked TriBE ensemble (CatBoost, XGBoost, LightGBM) cuts holdout MAE by 11.4–17.0% and RMSE by 8.6–15.8% over baselines.
A covariance-regularised PuLP MILP picks the XI, capturing 73.2–76.2% of oracle XI points across 1,579 test matches.
FastAPI endpoints, SHAP explanations and local Llama 3.2 rationales, backed by 137 tests.
Static Next.js site on Cloudflare Pages with Supabase accounts; it stays up when the model server is offline.
projects.filmCaption: Launch film I made for the NEW_X1 release

projects.title: Redrob Intelligent Candidate Discovery Engine
projects.description: Ranks 100,000 candidate profiles against a job description on CPU in under five minutes, with a written reason for every one of the top 100.
highlights: Led Team MM, four people, to a 7-stage hybrid search pipeline under the hackathon's CPU-only, five-minute budget.
A honeypot check removes misleading or low-quality profiles before any ranking.
Weighted BM25 and positive and negative recruiter-intent embeddings (BGE-base, FAISS), fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
A behavioural layer scores availability, market interest and trust as a multiplier that refines without filtering anyone out.
Cross-encoder re-ranking, then Qwen2.5 structured prompts produce calibrated scores with a written reason for each rank.
